title: The Big Mac Beat Inflation by $1.37
sentence: A US Big Mac cost $1.60 in 1986 and $6.22 in July 2026: had it only followed inflation, it would cost about $4.85, and even restaurant prices would only take it to $5.59.
source: The Economist, Big Mac index data (US price, Sept. 1986 and July 2026): https://github.com/TheEconomist/big-mac-data
US Bureau of Labor Statistics, CPI-U all items (CUUR0000SA0) and food away from home (CUUR0000SEFV), Sept. 1986 and July 2026: https://www.bls.gov/cpi/data.htm
